notes.title: FALLEN's Unity Build Demo
notes.content:
It has been a long time since the last update was made, so we are happy to release the Unity Demo Build for FALLEN! In this update, you'll see many newly refurbished elements from the art style to the music and writings. 

Hope you'll enjoy!
- Dusty

notes.title: FALLEN Final Demo
notes.content:
[b]Hello Warriors! Dusty here.[/b]

The time has arrived where the final build of the demo has alas appeared.

In this build, you will see :

[b]-LIVE2D sprites
-Animated CGs
-Reworked Battle Systems
-Wardrobe System[/b]

It took us a pretty long time to push this one out, mostly due to the integration of LIVE2D and another few things. But we hope that you'll give this final build a try and let us know about it in the comments.

Thanks!

notes.title: FALLEN Demo Release
notes.content:
[u][b]FALLEN's Official Demo is finally coming![/b]
[/u]
The demo will be launched during Steam's Upcoming Next Fest on the 1st of October. 

In this demo, [u]the first chapter of the finalized story[/u] will make its appearance. Alongside this, several newly added features will be showcased too.
